title: Workflow
description: A workflow of a mode: steps of four kinds, run one after another and saved after each.

trigger.description: What starts the workflow: an event, a schedule, or only a person.

event.description: The name of the event that starts it.

budget.description: Limits for a run of the workflow.

name.description: Kebab-case, starting with a letter; not constructor, a name every JavaScript object has.

budget.description: Limits for a run; every nested call draws from the same budget.

items.description: The most items the run may handle.

usd.description: The most US dollars the run may spend.

tokens.description: The most model tokens the run may use.

minutes.description: The most minutes the run may take.

step.description: One step: an action, an approval, a wait or a foreach.

action.description: An action of this mode, or interface.action of an interface it requires.

id.description: The step's id, unique in the whole file; its output is saved under it.

approval.description: The question put to the owner about the output of the step before.

id.description: The step's id, unique in the whole file; its output is saved under it.

wait.description: How long to wait, as a whole number of minutes, hours or days: 30m, 2h, 3d.

id.description: The step's id, unique in the whole file; its output is saved under it.

foreach.description: A JSON pointer to a list in the output of the step before; the steps run once per item.

id.description: The step's id, unique in the whole file; its output is saved under it.

steps.description: The steps run for each item, in order.
